metadata.title: Vintage Studio Portrait with Vertical Script

retrievalProfile.description: A monochrome studio portrait featuring a kneeling subject with a distinctive 90-degree rotated vertical script along the left margin.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white photograph of a woman kneeling in profile against a seamless studio backdrop, framed by a prominent vertical line of lowercase script text running up the left side of the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's profile faces right, creating a directional tension against the text on the left.
The vertical text acts as a structural border for the image.
The dark silhouette of the clothing contrasts sharply with the neutral grey backdrop.
The horizontal floor line anchors the kneeling figure within the square frame.
coreInvariants: Vertical text orientation rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise
Profile or three-quarter view of the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally but occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, kneeling on a flat surface.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark mass of the subject's torso and the vertical text block on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the vertical text on the left, follows the floor line to the subject's boots, and moves up the body to the face looking right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper left and right corners of the studio backdrop.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation monochrome with high value contrast between subject and background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid, rhythmic cursive script with connected lowercase letters.
letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with slight calligraphic modulation
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'p' and 'y' have elongated descenders that flow into the next word's space.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface usage to maintain minimalist retro aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the classic, fluid rhythmic script feel.
Provides a more casual, hand-drawn cursive quality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochrome studio photograph of a woman with long dark hair kneeling in profile, wearing a dark leotard and boots, against a grey seamless backdrop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of lowercase cursive script text vertically along the left edge, rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise, in solid black.

verificationChecks: Is the text rotated exactly 90 degrees?
Is the subject in a kneeling profile pose?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific name 'Carly Simon'
Do not replicate the exact lace detail of the original garment
Ensure the face is a generic model and not a specific celebrity likeness

mustAchieve: Clean studio lighting with soft shadows

postGenerationChecks: Text is positioned on the far left margin.
The subject is looking away from the text.
The floor and wall blend seamlessly.
The script is legible despite the rotation.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome studio portrait + [Subject Description] + [Vertical Script Font] on left margin rotated -90 degrees.
